messages.content: Rewrite plain English in the manner of Hegel's writing, as his nineteenth-century English translators render it. Keep the content exactly: every claim, example and step, in the same order, and add nothing.

Rewrite in Hegel's manner:

The plan said I would settle into the study to draft the reply to Dr. Lindner, but the morning has drifted into a quiet pause. I am still in the verandah chair, the white kurta cool against the skin. It is time to move from the verandah to the desk; the letter waits, and the file waits for the afternoon.
